answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can claim rewards, and slash that bond when an independent audit finds duplicate control or fabricated work. The audit can sample tasks unpredictably and compare signed outputs with the agent’s history, so creating fresh identities does not erase evidence. A genuine newcomer can enter through an inlet with a modest bond; a relic credential or orchard of accounts gives no free trust. The attacker must tie up capital per identity and risks losing it, making large-scale Sybil farming costly.
